greeting: Crystal of Truth on comms. Stage 4: The Crystal Awakens. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Shattered Light. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Approach the Crystal of Truth.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Approach the Crystal of Truth; Prove worthiness through honest intent; Form the bond with the Crystal. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Claim the Crystal of Truth and witness its power. Immediate move: Approach the Crystal of Truth.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: The Crystal Awakens. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Shadows in the Glass.
rumor: Prism scouts mapped a cave where colors refuse to stay attached to objects.
People keep repeating one clue from The Crystal Awakens: 'Form the bond with the Crystal'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn light in Prism reveals hidden seams in mirrored stone.
dialog.time_noon: Noon overcharges reflection grids. Angle your approach, do not rush centerline.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk doubles your silhouette count. Track teammate positions verbally.
dialog.time_night: Night turns crystal caverns into echo mazes. Keep line-of-sight discipline.

party_reactions.kade: Crystal of Truth sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Crystal of Truth accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Crystal of Truth talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
